title: Toggle Light Bulbs
summary: Given an array of integers between 1 and 100, each representing a light bulb's state, toggle the state of each bulb as specified.
statement: Given an array of integers between 1 and 100, each representing a light bulb's state, toggle the state of each bulb as specified. Return a sorted list of the bulbs that are on, or an empty list if none are on.
constraints: Each listed bulb ID toggles once in sequence.
Bulbs begin off; a repeated ID alternates between on and off.
Return all IDs left on in increasing order.
hints: Store currently on bulb IDs in a set.
Remove a listed ID if present; otherwise add it.
This symmetric toggle handles any repetition count.
Sort the final on-set for the required output order.
editorial: Sort the final on-set for the required output order.

tests.explanation: Ten toggles twice and is off; twenty and thirty remain on.
The same bulb toggles on then off, leaving an empty result.
